description: Temps d'attente par train en correspondance à Tours depuis/vers Port-de-Piles is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fnaut Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données recense l'ensemble des trains au départ ou à l'arrivée de Tours sur une journée, et met en évidence le temps d'attente avec les trains depuis ou vers Port-de-Piles. Horaires au service ferroviaire annuel 2026, débutant le 14/12/2025. Coverage: Fnaut Centre-Val de Loire. The publisher named on the listing is Fnaut Centre-Val de Loire. Its keywords include fnaut, navette, port-de-piles, adtt, temps-theorique, tours. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
